evidence.signature: view(view_id: str, members: Iterable[Fact], markdown: str) -> View

problem: The parenthesised list of group IDs (tool.trace.params, tools.core, edges.*, ceilings.table, env.all, env.deprecated, cli.all) reads as complete but isn't: extractors also build views such as scopes.options, duplication.commands, duplication.flags, duplication.reasons, resolver.strategy, resolver.bare_name, review.axes, review.grades, security.writes, env.<VAR>.default and tool.<name>.params for every tool.
replacement: Group IDs, which render a table or list over several facts (for example `edges.table`, `env.all` or `tool.<name>.params`), aren't in the snapshot because they have no value of their own.
route_reason: No extractor lists the view IDs as a fact, and an executed example only runs MCP tools, not the docs_facts tooling.
